title: ModerationDecision
description: Agent service to web service: the Moderation result (spec 03). Model errors, timeouts or invalid output always become hold with ruleCodes ["model_error"]; a valid model result with no rule hit but too little confidence to publish becomes hold with ruleCodes ["low_confidence"].

ruleCodes.description: Every rule that fired; empty only when decision is publish.

flaggedSpans.description: Exact spans of the submitted text that triggered a rule, shown to the author on authorFix and to the admin on hold.

authorMessage.description: Short author-facing message in the author's language.

ownHealthDataWarning.description: The author shared their own health details: a gentle warning only, never a hold (R8 note).

proofExtraction.description: Facts read from the Proof of Visit (spec 09), returned on every decision when a proof was sent and could be read by the model. The agent applies no date window and the proof never changes `decision`: the web service decides accepted, pending or rejected. Absent when no proof was sent or the extraction failed (model error, timeout or invalid output): the proof was not checked. Never carries the patient's name.
proofExtraction.title: ProofExtraction

readable.description: The document could be read at all.

isProofOfVisit.description: A receipt, invoice, kuitansi or appointment record of a dental visit.

clinicNameOnProof.description: The clinic or dentist name printed on it.

proofDate.description: The visit or payment date: YYYY-MM-DD when a day is printed, else YYYY-MM.

clinicNameMatches.description: The model's fuzzy judgment that the name on the proof is the Provider (typed or live Google name).
